_bus_comment: Maps logical device names to physical RS485 addresses.
_limits_comment: min_value/max_value: allowed voltage setpoint range in V. min_current_ua/max_current_ua: allowed current-limit range in uA (without them every current-limit command is refused). Re-run src/utils/build_registry.py after changing any of these.

arc_detection._comment: Software arc detection, every supply (a device entry can carry its own 'arc_detection' to override). An enabled supply whose output collapses below collapse_fraction x setpoint (or whose current exceeds overcurrent_ua) is latched as an arc -> stat_arc_exceeded -> PLC fault, until fault reset. Not judged below min_setpoint_kv, nor while the output is still coming up after an enable or setpoint change (until it reaches half the setpoint, or settle_s has passed). Read when the Spellman service starts.

source_einzel._note: Spellman 30kV unit (MPD30: 30 kV, 10 W, 0.33 mA max - max_current_ua is its rating)
